text: 对于一个不惜一切代价避免前瞻指引的央行而言，澳洲联储过去一个月在让金融市场为下周可能加息做准备方面做了不少引人注目的工作。值得注意的是，澳洲联储高层官员密集发表的言论，其目的或许也包括争取委员会内部的支持票。本着委员会公开辩论的精神，澳洲联储主席米歇尔·布洛克表示自己仅拥有“一票”表决权。非执行董事伊恩·罗斯本周表示，没有证据显示存在工资-价格螺旋。他的鸽派立场可能暗示下周投票可能出现分歧。
text_en: For a central bank that avoids forward guidance at all costs, the Reserve Bank of Australia has done a lot of conspicuous work over the past month to prepare financial markets for a possible rate hike next week. Notably, the密集 remarks by senior RBA officials may also have been aimed at securing support votes within the committee. In the spirit of open debate on the committee, RBA Governor Michele Bullock said she has only "one vote." Non-executive director Ian Ross said this week that there is no evidence of a wage-price spiral. His dovish stance may suggest a possible split in next week's vote.
